target.status: proposed working values only, explicitly 'offen' and not a user decision
target.source: ACCEPTANCE.md 'Prüfkonfiguration vor späterer Umsetzung konkretisieren' and operations/RENDERING.md
target.quote: 60 Hz Zielrate bei festgehaltener 1920×1080-Ausgabe (p95 Framezeit ≤16,7 ms; p99 ≤33,3 ms) und null sichtbar unbedeckte Terrainframes auf der gebundenen Prüftour

comparison_against_target.mobile_cold_tour: p95 11.78, p99 20.12, max 61.4 ms -> within proposed p95/p99
comparison_against_target.mobile_warm_tour: p95 11.90, p99 19.91, max 61.0 ms -> within proposed p95/p99

comparison_against_target.zero_uncovered_terrain_frames: not measured (clipmap missing_max 76-100 recorded, but visibility per frame unknown)

requirements.name: Frame times incl. distribution and spikes
requirements.evidence: p50/p95/p99/max overall and tour-only, top-8 spikes with frame index, counts >16.7/33.3/50/100/250 ms for 4 runs. Caveat: p50 ~8.4-8.5 ms matches 120 Hz ProMotion vsync cadence (no vsync/max_fps override in app/project.godot), so values are display-quantized, not render cost; no CPU/GPU time per pass.

requirements.name: Memory
requirements.evidence: RSS via ps every 0.5 s, static memory, GPU memory max. Mobile gpu_texture_memory_bytes_max = 1.8446744e19 (2^64, unsigned underflow) is invalid in both Mobile runs; no memory budget defined.

requirements.name: Load interruptions
requirements.evidence: Startup wait (26.8 s cold / 7.1 s warm) and startup spikes up to 14.4 s recorded; in-tour threshold counts present. No attribution of in-tour spikes (e.g. frames 2929-2931, 3563-3565) to loading vs. shader compile vs. GC.

requirements.name: Request age
requirements.evidence: terrain_streaming.oldest_request_ms_max is 0.0 in 3 of 4 runs and 73.0 in one; the tour uses the clipmap path, so this counter is likely not wired to the active path. clipmap tile_io_ms_max (162-489 ms) and tile_pending_max exist but are not request age.

requirements.name: Visible lateness
requirements.evidence: Only clipmap missing_max (76-100) from 80-93 sampled lines; no per-frame visible-hole/fallback metric, no screenshots/video, no time-to-visible.

requirements.name: Byte/time-bounded uploads
requirements.evidence: clipmap upload_ms_max 1.85-3.96 ms observed; terrain_streaming upload_max_ms 0.0 everywhere. No configured byte/time limit stated, no upload bytes per frame, so boundedness is not demonstrated.

requirements.name: Forward+ vs Mobile with identical workload
requirements.evidence: Same fixture/tour, same binary, same window. Identical terrain/streaming/material workload not shown: no per-renderer material/feature settings, frame counts differ (4654-4706 vs 5279-5286 tour frames) because vsync-free work differs, run order not counterbalanced (Forward+ always first, OS file cache and thermal state differ), n=1 per condition.

requirements.name: Named hardware, resolution, identical path
requirements.evidence: Apple M3 Pro 11C/14G, 18 GB, macOS 26.5, Godot 4.7.2 custom Metal, fixture runs/kit1-landscape-v5-2026-10-25/fixture.json all named. Resolution 640x360 is not the proposed 1920x1080 target and not realistic for a Retina display; raw runtime.json files are local-only (only SHA-256 committed), so values cannot be re-derived from the repo.

requirements.name: No cross-platform claims
requirements.evidence: README: 'Gilt nur für diesen Mac. Daraus folgt kein Windows-, Linux- oder iPad-Nachweis.' No contrary claim found.

consistency_checks.tour_vs_all: consistent: all huge spikes (frame 1-105) lie before tour_start_frame (125-293).
consistency_checks.warm_vs_cold: plausible: cold startup ~26.8 s vs warm ~7.1 s; tour statistics almost identical between cold and warm, so in-tour spikes are not first-run shader compile. Warm FP RSS max 1.54 GB > cold 1.30 GB (unexplained).
consistency_checks.rss_samples: FP cold 156 samples (78 s) ~ 26.8+48 s; Mobile cold only 137 samples (68.5 s) for the same ~75 s expected duration - small unexplained gap.
consistency_checks.identical_workload_claim: only path-identical; not frame- or material-identical (see requirements).

findings.detail: No bound target class: ACCEPTANCE.md leaves reference hardware, resolution, minimum performance, spike and memory budgets 'offen'; RENDERING.md values are unvalidated proposals. A12 'auf Zielklasse' cannot PASS without a bound target.

Measured at 640x360 (window intentionally capped pending owner decision) while the proposed target is 1920x1080. On a Retina M3 Pro this is ~1/9 of target pixels; fill-rate/GPU-bound costs are not represented, so neither pass nor fail against the target can be concluded.
Visible lateness and zero-uncovered-terrain-frames are not measured; clipmap missing_max 76-100 suggests many missing tiles at times but visibility is unknown.

Frame times appear vsync-locked to 120 Hz (p50 8.38-8.54 ms on ProMotion, no vsync override in project.godot). Statistics mix display cadence and missed vblanks; no CPU/GPU time per frame. State vsync mode and add GPU/CPU timings.
Mobile gpu_texture_memory_bytes_max = 1.8446744073708468e19 (2^64) is an underflow artefact; the memory column is invalid for Mobile and must be fixed or excluded.
terrain_streaming request age/upload are 0.0 in 3/4 runs, i.e. not effectively instrumented on the active clipmap path; request age and byte/time upload bounds are therefore not demonstrated.
Forward+ vs Mobile comparison is n=1 per condition, fixed order (Forward+ first), no material/feature parity statement; 'identical workload' is not proven.

Forward+ tour p95 16.77/16.765 ms already exceeds the proposed 16.7 ms at 640x360, with in-tour spikes to 134 ms (5 frames >100 ms); Mobile stays <=61 ms. At target resolution Forward+ is unlikely to improve.
Raw runtime.json files are local-only (only hashes committed); the aggregates cannot be re-derived or independently recomputed from the repository.
Thermal state, power source, other load and display refresh rate are not recorded; Mobile cold RSS sample count (137) is shorter than expected for the run duration.

needed_for_pass: Bind the target class as a documented technical test decision (device, OS, display refresh, resolution - e.g. 1920x1080 - p95/p99/max, spike and memory budgets) before measuring; owner decision on window size.
Re-measure at the bound target resolution with vsync mode stated (or vsync off plus separate CPU/GPU frame times).
Measure visible lateness per frame (uncovered/fallback terrain frames, time-to-visible) and show zero uncovered frames or an agreed tolerance.
Instrument request age and upload bytes/ms per frame on the active clipmap path and show they stay within configured limits.
Fix the Mobile GPU texture memory underflow; report peak RSS/GPU memory against a budget.
Run Forward+ and Mobile with documented feature/material parity, >=3 runs each, alternating order, thermal state recorded.
Commit or archive raw telemetry (runtime.json, RSS samples) so aggregates can be recomputed; then an independent review against the bound thresholds.
